summary: VS-020 research compendium provides comprehensive analysis of tool-gated gathering system with 250+ links, 30+ code samples, Kenney Survival Kit integration, and child-safety compliance. All acceptance criteria addressed with detailed implementation guidance.

strengths.description: Detailed analysis of current implementation gaps with clear identification of missing tool requirement checks. Document provides before/after comparison.
Multiple architecture approaches presented: component-based tools, tool registry pattern, state machines using AnimationTree, and custom state managers.
Complete Kenney Survival Kit integration guide with CC0 axe, pickaxe, tree, and stone models. Includes model paths and usage examples.
30+ advanced code samples covering tool system, interaction flow, state machines, respawn system, and inventory integration.
Strong emphasis on child-safety compliance: no timers, no grind quotas, no forced quests. Tool-based progression only.
Comprehensive testing approach for harvest feedback, inventory changes, respawn behavior, and physical proxies.
Detailed collision and Area3D patterns for reliable tool-resource interaction with proper feedback.
Extensive use of Kenney CC0 assets with proper attribution and integration patterns.

suggestions.description: Consider creating a migration guide for adding tool-gating to existing gatherable resources without breaking current gameplay.
Add a quick-start section at the top for developers new to the tool-gated system.

notes: The research identifies the current gap: gathering works without tool requirements.
All 5 acceptance criteria are addressed with implementation details.
250+ new links provide extensive external resources.
30+ code samples can be directly applied to the codebase.
Kenney Survival Kit integration is well-documented with CC0 assets.
Child-safety is a core principle: tool-based progression only, no timers/grind/quests.
The existing code has tool visuals and equipment system, but tool-gating check is missing from _gather_world_resource.

decision.reason: Comprehensive research document with deep enrichment meets all acceptance criteria. Provides complete implementation guidance for tool-gated gathering system. Ready for integration.
